title: Your Agent Is 80% Plumbing. Here Are the 12 Pieces You're Missing.
relevance_note: A deep dive into the infrastructure requirements of production-grade agents (Claude Code leak analysis), identifying 12 essential primitives beyond the LLM call.
reason_included: Critical for defining the 'Execution' and 'Recovery' blocks of the agentic harness.

claim_snippets.claim_text: The LLM call is only ~20% of a production agent system; the remaining 80% is plumbing (persistence, permissions, context budget, recovery).
Claude Code's source leak exposes 1,902 files and 29 subsystems, with a focus on session persistence and security stacks for shell commands.
